note: State park campground in woods on the inland side of Highway 61 on the North Shore, near Lutsen and the Cascade River gorge. Lake Superior's shore is 0.1-0.3 mile away across the highway. --Claude

Derived fcfs cleared. Coastal walk: NO (Hwy 61 lies between the campground and the shore). Not waterfront kept. Pin OK. Phone none -> 218-387-6000. Website 404 -> new URL.
flags: Waterfront / coastal walk: keep not waterfront. ReserveMN gives the drive-in sites 0.1-0.3 mile to Lake Superior, but imagery shows the whole campground on the inland side of Highway 61, which runs between every site and the shore; the brief's rule (a highway rules out coastal walk) applies. Only backpack site BP1 is marked 'Yes Lake Superior', and it is a hike-in site not counted for the entry.
